"""Run both existing 15k review paths one at a time when the pair is verified."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
COLLECTOR=ROOT/'review_queue_native_fixed.py'
results=[]
for action in ('monitor','native'):
    stage=ROOT/f'queue-{action}-015000.log'
    with stage.open('x') as outcome:
        status=subprocess.run((sys.executable,'-u',str(COLLECTOR),action,'15000'),
                              stdout=outcome,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=False).returncode
    results.append(status)
    print(action,status,flush=True)
raise SystemExit(any(results))
